title: fisk-ai A2A v1 no operator answer
description: Answers any of the four questions with the fact that the caller has nobody to ask. It is an answer rather than a failure and it fails closed: a gated command does not run, and the three human-in-the-loop tools answer the model with their own no-operator result. Send it when the person walks away rather than falling silent, which leaves the command unrun too but only after a whole window.
